name: Alpine rose and dwarf shrubs
desc: Low evergreen shrubs on acidic alpine slopes. Dwarf shrubs are part of the autumn and winter diet of Alpine ibex.
about: Rhododendron ferrugineum, the alpenrose, snow-rose, or rusty-leaved alpenrose is an evergreen shrub that grows just above the tree line in the Alps, Pyrenees, Jura Mountains and northern Apennine…
